catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results: net loss widened to $183.2M (-$1.55/diluted share) from -$0.81/share in Q3 2025; nine-month net loss $469.5M (-$4.03/share) vs -$1.80/share a year earlier; R&D expense $166.8M vs $90.0M; cash/cash equivalents/short-term investments ~$960M including ~$550M net proceeds from a September 2026 financing; VK2735 Phase 3 (VANQUISH) programs continuing to advance

Viking Therapeutics reported Q3 2026 results after market close: net loss widened to $183.2M (vs $90.8M in Q3 2025); 9-month net loss $469.5M. Pipeline update: oral VK2735 SUNRISE Phase 3 program initiated; subcutaneous VANQUISH 1/2 Phase 3 trials continuing on track, expected completion 2027; VK3019 (amylin agonist) Phase 1 single-ascending-dose study nearing completion, 28-day multiple-ascending-dose study expected to start Q1 2027.
catalysts.impact: Confirmed the scheduled earnings date went ahead; stock-price reaction unconfirmed (see conflicts)

Viking Therapeutics announced it will report Q3 2026 results after market close on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, with a conference call at 4:30pm ET

Viking announces positive topline results from VK2735 maintenance-dosing study: 22% placebo-adjusted weight loss at week 33 (no plateau observed); patients switching from weekly to every-other-week dosing retained up to 97% of prior weight loss, and up to 90% with monthly dosing (vs ~61% retention on placebo); GI side effects during maintenance similar to placebo
catalysts.impact: Stock surged intraday; reported magnitude ranges +27% to +39% depending on source/timing (see conflicts)

catalysts.headline: Truist Securities called the VK2735 maintenance readout a 'best case scenario'; Oppenheimer raised price target to $120 from $100 (Outperform)

Viking filed Form S-3ASR shelf registration enabling future capital raises to fund VK2735 subcutaneous and oral Phase 3 programs; company also completed a ~$159.6M follow-on equity raise around this period
catalysts.impact: dilutive financing event; extends balance sheet

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: GAAP EPS -$1.10 (beat consensus -$1.21 by $0.11); $502M cash and investments at June 30, 2026, which the company said funds operations into 2028; VANQUISH 1 (obesity) and VANQUISH 2 (obesity + T2D) Phase III trials for VK2735 remain on track and fully enrolled; oral VK2735 Phase III expected to start Q4 2026
